tips: She is able to parry kled's Q "bear trap on a rope" and also has insane dps. You have to be very safe in this lane and will have to look to freeze the wave near your turret otherwise she will run you down the lane with her mobility from her passive vitals along with her q and melt your hp bar.

Can block your autos with his e "counterstike" which negaties your main source of dmg coming from kled's W "violent tendancies". He has good lane pressure and scales insanely well. Look to freeze the wave near your turret and setup for ganks for your jgler otherwise he will run you down with his leap and dps you with ease.

Has super high base stats and can 100 to 0 you early on if you are not carefully with her passive autos + her q since her q does percent health damage which counters kled due to his and skaarl's hp bars making him having the highest base health in the game. She also can negate your e "jousting" with her W which will cancel the dash and silence you. She is also very tanky. Look to q farm early on and last hitting minions, and try to freeze waves near your turret in order to setup ganks.

Camille is able to pick fights whenever she desires with her passive shield. She also has high base dmg and has max hp dmg from her w along with true dmg from her q. In this lane look to poke her with q "bear trap on a rope" and try to bait out her passive shield before engaging on her.

Kennen is able to pick fights whenever he desires with his range advantage in the lane. He is able to disengage very easily with his e + passive w stun and is a pain to punish since he can just sit back and q farm until his jungler is ready for a gank. In this lane look to q "bear trap on a rop" farm and freeze the wave near your turret until your jungler is able to assist you.

Does a ton of burst damge with his q when he has full passive stacks, also can block your autos with his e and has good dive potential with his jungler. Build D sheild and look to farm under your turret and poking him with your q.

Has has insanely high damage with his q and e, he has free healing and free tenacity, along with a deadly ult for when you are dismounted. Look to poke him with q "bear trap on a rope" while farming and setup ganks for your jungler.

has high base dmg from his passive shotgun knees. In this lane you want to look to poke him with q from lvs 1-3, once you have your full combo you want to look for engages when you have the minion wave on your side of the lane along with when he wastes his q or w on the wave. Look to freeze the wave early to force him to have to walk up and attempt to shove the wave in with his abilities. D shield is a good starting item for this lane because it allows you to walk up more in the lane without having the threat of getting hard poked pre lv 3/4 where you can start to look for engages/fights. Once urgot hits lv 6 you have to be careful when you are getting low and about to get dismounted since if e's or q's you when u are dismounted it is easy for him to hit his ult and execute you since your max hp is including skaarls so once you are dismounted you are very vulnerable to the execute.

Teemo's Q "blind dart" makes you miss all your AA's when it is active on you- negating your w "violent tendencies" if you attack during it, and he has high DoT damage. Build MR, get an oracle lens, he is squishy if you get on top of him while his Q is on CD.

Has high dmg early on with his q and e. Look to poke him with q and setup a freeze if possible. If you see him waste his shield "w" look for trades when ur full combo is up. Go D shield in this lane so you don't get poked out early.

Look to q poke him early and try to bait out his w before looking for extended trades by either walking up with your q on him or by using your e onto him then kiting away with the move speed from your e and then e back onto him as his w is expiring. Look to rush black cleaver in this lane.

Has high dmg early on with her q and her passive. Look to poke her with q and setup a freeze if possible. If you see him waste his shroud "w" look for trades when ur full combo is up. Go D shield in this lane so you don't get poked out early.

has high base dmg, need to be careful for his passive stacks, look for short trades and poke him out with q. Look to free the wave near your turret and setup ganks for your jg. Use your e on top of darius when he channels his q so he cant heal.

has high base dmg, need to be careful for his fury bar since he does a ton of dmg with him empowered w, look for short trades and poke him out with q. Look to free the wave near your turret and setup ganks for your jg.
her passive does a lot of dps when stacked, look for trades when she doesn't have her passive stacks built up, otherwise look to q farm until the stacks run out.

avoid her e if possible, it is her main source of dmg output, if she hits her e she can 100 to 0 you, but if she misses she becomes very easy to kill. You can play aggressive pre 6, just make sure to dodge her e.

can easily dodge his e with ur e. Make sure to go for short trades since his passive does a lot of dps if you take extended fights. Pre 6 you can look to play aggressive in lane but after 6 you have to be careful because of his ult since it takes away some of your defensive and offensive stats which will make it hard for you to remount against him.

has high dmg due to his passive giving him crit chance, in this lane look to trade with him when his fury bar is low, lvs 3-5 is when u have an advantage in this lane, look to punish him when he wastes his e or if he has low fury. Once he hits 6 you have to be careful since he can turn a fight very easily with his ult.

only does dmg with his q and is easily avoidable, look to set up waves near your turret and when he walks up you can hard engage on him with your eq combo, look to hold onto the 2nd part of ur e to dodge his q.
Has decent base armor but can't really all in you. Look to poke with q early in the lane and once you chunk him to around 60% hp you can start to look for all ins with your combo.
Very weak early game, look to abuse him as much as possible. Look to freeze waves near your turret so he is forced to walk up to you so you can all in him with a full lane to work with.

you can dodge his crit q's with your e and you have healing reduction on your q "bear trap on a rope" making his healing weak. Look to poke with q and all in whenever he is pushed up the lane when the opportunity presents itself.

Low base damage, for the most part once you hit lv 3 you can look for all ins when your full combo is up (q,w,e). Be aware once he gets his ult when you are playing near his turret since he will look to ult you under turret.
You have healing reduction on your q "bear trap on a rope" making his healing weak. Look to poke with q and all in whenever he is pushed up the lane when the opportunity presents itself.
Very weak early game, look to abuse her as much as possible. Look to freeze waves near your turret so she is forced to walk up to you so you can all in him with a full lane to work with.
Clap him early, or you'll be clapped for the rest of the game. Cho only has his knockup to disengage, his slow won't bother you as much.
Mundo has low mobility, so it's easy to land combo's. Dodge his Q poke and all in when possible. He will most likely outscale you, so it's important you bully him for as long as possible.
You'll win this lane as long as you hit your Q-E combo. However, there is some outplay potential on Gangplank's side, this is why this matchup isn't considered a Tiny thread.
If you're playing against a good Gnar, you'll never be able to get close to them. If he for some reason uses his jump, try to all in. Try to dodge his boomerang and play around his cooldowns.
BOMBA Lots of disengage, lots of mobility. Either you or Gragas misplays, that's the person who loses lane.
Gwen is one of the strongest AP mages, try to avoid her fully stacked Q with your E. If you bully her early, you should be able to bully her for the rest of the game.

As long as you don't get poked down early, you'll win every all in. If you're equal to Jayce / misplay a fight, you are quite likely to die in an all in, since he can one shot you dismounted when behind. Try to land an E on him, or you won't be able to do much.
Becomes a really hard lane after level 6, before that bully hard. You should be able to out trade him, but try to avoid his Q's. This will give him Max Health True Damage.
She doesn't have that much damage early, try to all in when possible. You have to land your dash on her, if she dashes out, you'll be able to follow.
Extremely easy early. Try to bully him as much as possible in this stage of the game. He will move up to minor at level 6, even at level 11 and major at level 16.
As long as you dodge her charm, you can all in her early. If the Ahri is good, she will afk farm until level 6. Try to deny as much farm/xp as possible.
All in when her stun is down, then the lane is very easy. Be careful when she hits level 6 and you're dismounted, she can Flash-W(Stun)-Ult-Q.
All in when he's overextended, the thread will only increase when he starts gaining stacks.
Very hard to get near him, he will poke you really easily. Only all in when he used his dash. A good azir will never die.
Always has a lot of damage and poke. As long as you avoid all spells, you should be good.
He doesn't have that much damage, try to all in when possible.

Cassiopeia's W is hell. You will never be able to go in when it's up. The cooldown is very high early, try to bait it there. Once she uses it, you will be able to go in. This is a horrible ability to play against in later teamfights. Once you're dismounted, there's not much you will be able to do.
This man has a 2k shield for some reason. Try to stay outside his stun zone, this will have a 22-second cooldown for most of the game. Try to outplay.
Try to stay back before level 6, unless he only has 1 turret up. Once you're level 6, you can all in with your ult.
A good Kennen won't let you go near him, this will mean he will just poke you down. Try to land your dash when going in, if you don't hit it, you will be poked when walking back.
I still have no idea what this champion does, becomes a Major thread when reaching level 6.
Hard to hit Q on because of the high movement speed. Need help from jungler for this one.
Dodge her root, all in, kill.
Has low mana, very immobily. Stick on him with dash when his Q is down, if it's up he will simply outrun you.
Has a lot of poke, stay back while laning or go all in. Either one works. His ult doesn't have that much effect on you, you can escape his suppression when demounting.

Has good poke with her Q, so try not to stand directly in a line with her and minions, since her ability can shatter on them. If you go in, she'll most likely root you and then dash away. If she uses either one, you are able to go in. But always make sure you land your dash on her. At level 6, you can also go for this combo: (flash,) E, Q, R. Your ult will cause you to go through her root.

Dodge root, or she'll deal a lot of damage. If you hit her with Q or E before she sends out her clone, you can see which one is the real one. But don't go in before she used her root, or your ult is up to become unstoppable.

Has high all-in potential. If he has ignite, you'll lose level 1. If he doesn't, you'll be able to fight if you hit your Q. Either way, it's still a really hard matchup. In case you can zone him to wait out his ult level 6, that would be the best case scenario. However, if you can't, try to ult out, he will kill you if you're even in lane.

Orianna is quite the counter to Kled, try to wait for jungler or all in when she uses all her abilities. Her abilities are lower than Kled's throughout most of the game, it won't be until level 14 that your abilities will have lower cooldowns.

Qiyana is useless when behind, and even if ahead, you still counter a part of her kit. Your Q and E both reveal her while she's invisible. But don't forget, if you play against a Qiyana that knows what she's doing, she will be able to outplay you hard. Just try to punish her in lane by hitting full combos on her.

You can only go in when you land your E on her, since she will knock you back a lot. With stridebreaker, this matchup is much easier, even though it's out of the meta, it's usually worth it in this matchup.

Punish early. If he gets his thornmail when you're even in lane, Rammus becomes a major threat. Rush Black Cleaver and other % armor reduction items. He will most likely try to proxy early, so wait for him in the jungle.
Never fight level 1. Poke her down, she has no sustain in lane. You should win an all in at levels 3-5. After level 6, you should be a bit more careful. She kills with ignite + ult.
His root is really annoying, only go in when his abilities are down, or your ult is up.

Insane damage & sustain. If you know how to play around his W & E this matchup is rated even. If you are able to get ahead, Sett will be a cannon minion. Try saving your E for his W, since this is one of his main sources of damage.

Take TP into this matchup. Don't chase Singed. Singed wants to go equal in lane, we don't. Try to punish mistakes and bully him hard. If he were to proxy, try to ask your jungler for help. If your jungler can't come, try to play around your TP cooldown. Consider buying cull and tiamat.
Dodge his grab, then all in. You counter most of his kit, should be an easy win.
His cooldowns are very high, bully him for anything. Even if he lands his E2 on you, you should still be able to out trade him. Try to play aggressive early, this is where he will be at his weakest.

You can never go in when her E is up, you can never be dismounted near her when ult is up. But since all of her basic abilities are skillshots, this is a skill based matchup before lv6. At level 6, you can ult and instantly E to stick on her.
She has 2 abilities that counter your kit, when those are down, you'll be able to go in. She usually uses them for waveclear, that's your moment to go in.

Don't get hit when the blades return on W. He will be able to combo it into a Q and deal a lot of damage with his passive bleed. If you're dismounted, try staying at a reasonable distance. The only reasonable distance when he's level 6, is your fountain.

Another Lethal Tempo abuser. Trundle players are often very agressive, so try to save your dash for escaping. He will usually just run at you, so throw your Q as he's walking towards you, use all your W's, flee with E. At level 6 when going even, I would actually recommend saving your R as an escape tool.

Go all in after he uses his W, this will be his only form of CC. Try to stick on him for as long as possible. Most Twisted Fate's put their first point in W, so there's no reason to cheese level 1. You will be out poked. Try to go in at level 3-5.

This is all a matter of wave management and scaling. If you can beat him early, he will be a cannon minion until 30 minutes. However, if you do not manage to beat him in lane and bully him there, you will have an extremely hard time with him. You can ult through his cage, but his ult will execute you when you're dismounted.

Dodge his knockup, then all in. At level 6, this matchup will only be easier. However, if you end up dismounted in an all in and Vel'Koz doesn't die. He will simply ult you to death. So make sure the prey doesn't escape.
Her poke is annoying, but she can't do anything against your engage when her fear is down.
Dash out of his stun zone with your E, if you do this, he can't do anything against you early.

Just wait for jungler honestly, if he zones you, poke with Q. Rush any anti-heal item. If you're dismounted, don't stay, he can ult you from (what it feels like) across the map. If you are confident with playing flash + ignite, take it. You don't necessarily need the flash, you could run tp + ignite into this lane.
Don't get baited into chasing, his W heals for so much, even with your anti-heal. If you die 2 times, you'll die 10 times. Try to take short trades when his abilities are down.
You will not be able to get near him until level 6. After level 6, it becomes a minor thread, due to you having ult. So don't feed him early.

With the removal of Lethal Tempo, Yasuo is a much easier matchup. However, you cannot underestimate his damage. He is rather weak early if you manage to sidestep his Q's. If you dodge them, you should be able to win lv1. If not, you will most likely lose to his CC.

With the removal of Lethal Tempo, Yone is a much easier matchup. However, you cannot underestimate his damage. He is rather weak early if you manage to sidestep his Q's. If you dodge them, you should be able to win lv1. If not, you will most likely lose to his CC.

All of Yorick's disengage comes from his cage. If you manage to hit an E on him, his cage will be useless, since your E2 can dash through walls. Try to get an early lead, since Yorick can deal a lot of damage when he's ahead or even equal to you. Expect him to split all game long, so take TP into this matchup.

Try to get a lead before level 6, since this is where most of his damage comes from poke. He will try to Q you level 1, or combo it with an W-E-Q combo at level 3. If you are right on top of him, and he dashes away with W, the E mark should still be on him. This is how you can out trade Zed. Becomes an even matchup at level 6.
Only has her sleep which is really annoying. Try to dodge her spells, if you can't, this is a major thread.

High CC, NEVER play agressive when you're dismounted and Ornn's abilities are up. He can 200-0 you while you're CC'd. You can dodge his W with your E, this way he loses a lot of damage, because he won't have his Brittle mark on you. Don't overextend when he has ult up and you're dismounted, that thing is undodgable when dismounted.

Don't get hit by his Q, Tahm Kench can stick on you really easily, but you out trade him as long as you dodge his Q. Tahm Kench wins longer trades, due to his sustain. Your only tool to stop his E is with your Q and R once you hit level 6. If you used both, predict where he is going to jump. Tahm Kench's E animation takes long enough for you to walk over.

Fight level 3-5, only fight level 6 if you're ahead, even then it'll be scary. When fighting level 3-5 you HAVE to land your E, if you don't, you'll lose the fight. She will try to poke you down early, try to stay back as far is possible, the wave will slow push into you. You will take some damage under turret, since she can poke you down under it (fair and balanced). Recall once you clear the wave, tp back, now you should be level 3, all in here.

Anivia is very weak until level 6. Until then, she will not have any sort of wave clear. Try to bait a stun, it's a very slow travelling ability, so it should be easy to dodge when far away. Don't try to face it head on, Anivia can control when the stun ball explodes. If you think you can kill her in the middle of the lane, do it. Flash if you must for an early kill. It's really worth delaying her level 6.

Hard matchup, even when you stick on him, he will still out damage you. He even has an execute at level 6 for when you're dismounted. Be aware that his ult can be blocked by towers and minions. He will be very vulnerable in a 1v2, try to ask for a gank. Once he's behind, it should be much easier to play, it might even become a Minor thread.

Varus will unlock his only form of CC at level 6, until then, he is immobile and very vulnerable. Try to all in at any possibility. If they're playing AP Varus, they shouldn't be able to get back into the game until the 30th minute.

A good Hwei will never use his CC before you go in or he doesn't have the chance to run away. This could be troublesome, since he does have the ability to poke you down. If he uses his CC, go all in. Upon hitting level 6, you could look for an all-in, since you should burst him quite easily.

Kled is one of the few champions who can counter Aurora top, do to his ability to stick to her and reveal her while invisible. Aurora will attempt to poke you a lot pre 6, but her abilities are rather easy to sidestep. Buy boots early and look for a kill from level 3-5. Once she reaches level 6 the lane becomes much harder, because of her overflowing amount of escape tools. Try to keep you ult and use it when her ult ends.
